name: Mefcom Capital Markets Limited
about: Mefcom Capital Markets Limited engages in the capital market operations and merchant banking activities in India. The company operates through Trading in Shares & Securities and Merchant Banking Service. It provides trading services in equities, derivatives, currency, and commodities for day traders, jobbers, including proprietary trading in shares and securities, and arbitrageurs; support services, including margin funding, loan against shares, and links to daily trading strategies; and wealth management services. The company also offers value-added services, such as SMS alerts, and a daily/weekly newsletter giving information on daily/weekly market commentary and trading strategies. In addition, it provides investment banking services related to IPOs, private placement, and bond offerings, as well as acts as a broker for mergers and acquisitions. Further, it offers investment planning services, which comprise public issues management, capital restructuring, private equity, debt syndication, advisory, corporate, loan against equity shares, and valuations. Additionally, the company provides financial advisory services and capital market solutions to initial public offerings (IPOs), follow-on public offerings (FPOs), acquisitions and takeovers, rights issues, and other financial advisory solutions for clients. Mefcom Capital Markets Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
